properties.name: management.endpoint.integrationgraph.access
properties.description: Permitted level of access for the integrationgraph endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.integrationgraph.cache.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time that a response can be cached.

properties.name: spring.integration.channel.auto-create
properties.description: Whether to create input channels if necessary.

properties.name: spring.integration.channel.max-broadcast-subscribers
properties.description: Default number of subscribers allowed on, for example, a 'PublishSubscribeChannel'.

properties.name: spring.integration.channel.max-unicast-subscribers
properties.description: Default number of subscribers allowed on, for example, a 'DirectChannel'.

properties.name: spring.integration.endpoint.default-timeout
properties.description: Default timeout for blocking operations such as sending or receiving messages.

properties.name: spring.integration.endpoint.no-auto-startup
properties.description: List of endpoint bean names patterns that should not be started automatically during application startup.

properties.name: spring.integration.endpoint.read-only-headers
properties.description: List of message header names that should not be populated into Message instances during a header copying operation.

properties.name: spring.integration.endpoint.throw-exception-on-late-reply
properties.description: Whether to throw an exception when a reply is not expected anymore by a gateway.

properties.name: spring.integration.error.ignore-failures
properties.description: Whether to ignore failures for one or more of the handlers of the global 'errorChannel'.

properties.name: spring.integration.error.require-subscribers
properties.description: Whether to not silently ignore messages on the global 'errorChannel' when there are no subscribers.

properties.name: spring.integration.jdbc.continue-on-error
properties.description: Whether initialization should continue when an error occurs when applying a schema script.

properties.name: spring.integration.jdbc.initialize-schema
properties.description: Database schema initialization mode.

properties.name: spring.integration.jdbc.platform
properties.description: Platform to use in initialization scripts if the @@platform@@ placeholder is used. Auto-detected by default.

properties.name: spring.integration.jdbc.schema
properties.description: Path to the SQL file to use to initialize the database schema.

properties.name: spring.integration.management.default-logging-enabled
properties.description: Whether Spring Integration components should perform logging in the main message flow. When disabled, such logging will be skipped without checking the logging level. When enabled, such logging is controlled as normal by the logging system's log level configuration.

properties.name: spring.integration.management.observation-patterns
properties.description: List of simple patterns to match against the names of Spring Integration components. When matched, observation instrumentation will be performed for the component. Please refer to the javadoc of the smartMatch method of Spring Integration's PatternMatchUtils for details of the pattern syntax.

properties.name: spring.integration.poller.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for polling. Mutually exclusive with 'fixedDelay' and 'fixedRate'.

properties.name: spring.integration.poller.fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling delay period. Mutually exclusive with 'cron' and 'fixedRate'.

properties.name: spring.integration.poller.fixed-rate
properties.description: Polling rate period. Mutually exclusive with 'fixedDelay' and 'cron'.

properties.name: spring.integration.poller.initial-delay
properties.description: Polling initial delay. Applied for 'fixedDelay' and 'fixedRate'; ignored for 'cron'.

properties.name: spring.integration.poller.max-messages-per-poll
properties.description: Maximum number of messages to poll per polling cycle.

properties.name: spring.integration.poller.receive-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for messages on poll.

properties.name: spring.integration.rsocket.client.host
properties.description: TCP RSocket server host to connect to.

properties.name: spring.integration.rsocket.client.port
properties.description: TCP RSocket server port to connect to.

properties.name: spring.integration.rsocket.client.uri
properties.description: WebSocket RSocket server uri to connect to.

properties.name: spring.integration.rsocket.server.message-mapping-enabled
properties.description: Whether to handle message mapping for RSocket through Spring Integration.
